reconciliation_notes: Both verifiers recommend GOLD-trust with the load-bearing values confirmed, but reconciliation rules force one-step downgrades on the disputed load-bearing fields, so the twin lands at SILVER (= lowest load-bearing tier). Field decisions: (1) onchip_sram_capacity_bytes = 230,686,720 B (220 MiB) held at GOLD -- both verifiers + vendor + ISCA agree, sole device memory / no HBM confirmed. (2) onchip_sram_bw_bps kept at 8.0e13 (vendor 80 TB/s) but downgraded GOLD->SILVER: verifier-2 surfaced the ISCA paper's ~27.5 TiB/s internal-SRAM figure; 80 TB/s is the aggregate across all concurrent stream lanes -- value retained (vendor headline the experiments expect) with the definitional caveat recorded. (3) device_peak_flops_bf16 = 1.88e14 value confirmed by both, downgraded to SILVER because the 188 TFLOPS is published as FP16 (no native BF16 path; FP32 accumulate) -- a datatype-label nuance, not a numeric dispute. (4) per_instance_mac_s = 9.4e13 (=188 TFLOPS/2) kept SILVER; sits ~2% above the self-consistent 320x320x900MHz = 9.216e13 derivation. instances=1, matrix_unit [320,320,1] retained. peak_int8_tops (7.5e14), clock_hz (9.0e8), process_node (14nm), vector_alus (5120) all confirmed GOLD. host_bw_bps 3.15e10 kept SILVER (PCIe Gen4 x16 link-standard inference). (5) tdp_w: DISPUTED -- authored 215W (vendor spec-sheet chip-level TDP) could not be reproduced by adversarial re-search, which found GroqCard board ~240W avg / 375W max and ~300W TDP elsewhere; kept 215W as the chip-level figure but downgraded to BRONZE and annotated. tdp is non-load-bearing so it does not drop the twin tier. (6) onchip_sram_energy_pj_per_byte (1.0) and line_bytes (320) remain BRONZE estimates (Groq publishes neither; ISCA documents 32 B/lane stream width) -- both are non-load-bearing per the grading rule (only BW/peak/capacity gate the tier), so they do not force twin=BRONZE. Final twin: SRAM-only RB-05 chain backing sram (220 MiB @ 80 TB/s, role:sram) -> reuse sram (SXR stream-register staging, estimate) -> compute leaf (mxm, instances=1, 9.4e13 MAC/s, [320,320,1], dtype 2 / acc 4, 900 MHz). Device-peak sanity: 9.4e13 x 1 x 2 = 1.88e14 FLOP/s = 188 TFLOPS, order 1e14 (~1/5 of H100 dense BF16 0.99 PFLOP/s) -- passes anchor.
unresolved: reuse tier (SXR stream/vector register staging) capacity_bytes is an estimate (~256 KB) -- Groq does not publish the per-MXM operand-staging capacity; the 3-level schema is satisfied but the reuse C-block cap is not a measured number.
onchip_sram_bw_bps definitional gap: vendor 80 TB/s (aggregate stream lanes) vs ISCA ~27.5 TiB/s internal SRAM BW; kept vendor figure but true single-stream effective BW is bounded lower.
tdp_w = 215W (chip-level spec sheet) vs adversarial finds of ~240W avg / 375W max (GroqCard board) and ~300W TDP; unresolved whether 215W is bare-die or an outdated/erroneous figure.
onchip_sram_energy_pj_per_byte (1.0 read / 1.2 write) is an unpublished 14nm estimate -- directional only.
line_bytes = 320 is a modeling assumption (320-element matrix row); vendor documents 32 B/lane stream width, so the true ISA burst granularity may be 32 B.
